newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a virtual standstill on Tuesday, with prices on steers and heifers not established on dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), according to USDA. Buyer inquiry and demand moderate to firm, Seller interest light.
Dressed Basis Steers: No confirmed sales.
Dressed Basis Heifers: No confirmed sales.
Prices also were not established on steers or heifers on a live basis. Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Heifers: No confirmed sales Sales confirmed: None. For the week: 10,400
